findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler but does not implement its abstract methods: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. Because StatefulDetectorHandler is an ABC, MetricAlertDetectorHandler remains abstract. Detector.detector_handler calls group_type.detector_handler(self), and MetricAlertFire.detector_handler is MetricAlertDetectorHandler, so any attempt to use a metric alert detector will raise TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler. This is a regression from the previous DetectorHandler subclass that had a concrete evaluate method.

findings.title: KeyError when StatefulDetectorHandler has no counter_names
findings.body: In get_state_data, counter_updates is initialized to {} and only populated when self.counter_names is non-empty (lines 196-208). In the results loop, counter_updates=counter_updates[gk] unconditionally indexes that dict. If a concrete StatefulDetectorHandler returns an empty list for counter_names, counter_updates remains {} and this line raises KeyError for every group key, crashing evaluation. Subclasses that do not need counters should still get a default empty dict per group key.

findings.title: Docstring still says evaluate returns a list
findings.body: The StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate docstring says "returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult" but the method now returns dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult] after this PR. The documentation should be updated to avoid misleading future readers.

findings.title: Test expected occurrence built with wrong group key causing test failure
findings.body: In TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe, the expected_result uses group_key="group_key" (line 540), but the IssueOccurrence for result is generated by build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", ...) on line 536. The actual evaluate_group_key_value call uses expected_result.group_key ("group_key"), so build_occurrence_and_event_data will produce an occurrence with fingerprint based on "group_key". DetectorEvaluationResult equality compares the IssueOccurrence fields including fingerprint, so the assertion will fail. The occurrence should be built with the same group_key ("group_key") as expected_result.
